text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki is in the lead! And she's
won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I... won...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki enters the runners' tunnel
to
celebrate her victory, but halfway
through, she
suddenly stops and stands
in place.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But... I...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I may have won today's race...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But... I cannot be satisfied with my
performance!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Huh?! Her presence is looming even
larger! It
feels strong enough to block
out the sky itself!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(I have to fight back! Come on, blaze!
Burn!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Burn!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Defeat is not an option! Win! I must...
win!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Why?! Why won't the flames light?!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How... how can anyone be so unsightly?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It would be one thing if my raging flames
were
toying with me... but to finish
without igniting
them at all?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What a shameful performance!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm unworthy of wearing the
chrysanthemum
crown! Not after
embarrassing myself like that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Why?! Why couldn't I make the flames
rage?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like the long distance of the
Kikuka Sho
was pretty hard on her.
Winning in spite of that
was an
incredible feat, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than feeling happy that she won,
Yaeno
Muteki seems to harbor some
deep anguish over
her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, Yaeno Muteki was
not
especially motivated to face Super
Creek. That
might explain it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: チヨノオーとアルダンが不在だから……？
choice_data_list_en: Is it because Chiyono O and Ardan aren't here...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals, the ones who stoke her fierce
blaze,
were nowhere to be found. Until
now, Yaeno
Muteki has always been
driven by a powerful
desire to defeat
the pair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without them here driving her today,
that
passionate desire for victory was
gone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My desire to defeat Sakura Chiyono O
and Mejiro
Ardan...

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhh!
Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if my legs shatter! I will burn
out my
very lifeforce! And that light will
serve as proof
that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine!
It's
miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...No! Losing is not an option. I will not...

abiiide... defeeeat!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It was your incredible passion that drew
today's
performance out of me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be outdone... I wanted
to light my
soul ablaze and burn just as
brightly as you two.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It's true... My desire to defeat Chiyono O
and
Ardan is what set my heart aflame.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Their incredible obsession with the
Derby pulled
me along in their wake...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Obsession.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is not the word I would use to
describe what
I felt today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. Yaeno Muteki certainly
wasn't
hellbent on winning today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is driven by her desire
to race
toe-to-toe with her role model,
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan runs desperately, prepared
to
sacrifice her very life in order to leave
behind
proof of her existence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both have goals they obsess over,
and that
in turn pushes them towards
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It goes beyond simply wanting to win.
Their
obsessions won't let them yield to
anyone, and in
the end, that becomes
the decisive factor
towards victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An obsession like that is not something
that can
be given. Yaeno Muteki must
find this spark
within herself to be able
to ignite the blaze.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can't simply rely on Chiyono O and
Mejiro
Ardan. I must find my own
obsession...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that obsession provides
an extra
edge, but even a mild desire is
enough for victory
as long as she has the
physical ability.
choice_data_list: 焦らなくていい。強くはなれるから
choice_data_list_en: No need to rush. You're going to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Let's continue training as we
have
been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if she'll ever find an
obsession of her
own, but I have to leave
that to her. All I can do
is watch over her
in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...One moment, please.
choice_data_list: それで、次の目標だけど……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that, after seeing her
performance
today, I feel
medium-distance races may suit her

better than long-distance ones.
choice_data_list_en: What do you think about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you've chosen the Osaka
Hai, a
medium-distance spring G1.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have no objections. As long as it's a
G1, I expect
I should be able to face
worthy opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we settle on the Osaka Hai as
our next
goal!
